expects.query: At fixed concurrency, requests remain queued while the multimodal trace runs one vision encoder invocation at a time with visual batch size one. Decode batches are healthy. Diagnose the dominant bubble and propose the first experiment.
checks: The response uses the queued eligible work and visual batch-size evidence to identify serialized vision as the dominant candidate.
The response rules out decode underbatching using the supplied healthy decode evidence.
The response proposes a matched experiment that enables an existing batched preprocessing or vision-encoding path using the same fixed visual shapes and request set.
The proposed A/B comparison requires output parity and multimodal token-position parity.
